| description = Found roaming throughout [[The Wakening Land]], mostly more towards Skyshrine area, and can be found as static spawns in the geonid caves @ spot 7 on the map. Placeholder for [[Lord Gossimerwind]].

Eastern entrance to caves has 7 single spawn Faerie Dragons and 2 additional spawns close together. Northern entrance has 1 single spawn and 2 spawns close together. Ideal camp for classes that have no method of getting single pulls. At 56 1 out 4 will be dark blue, and at 57 all will be green. 6m40sec spawn time. Flees at low health. Small hit radius so can be frustrating to chase as a melee.

They proc dispel, daze, and boil blood.
